## ConnectionService.createTrustPing() method

Create a trust ping message for the connection with the specified connection id.

By default a trust ping message should elicit a response. If this is not desired the `config.responseRequested` property can be set to `false`.

<b>Signature:</b>

```typescript
createTrustPing(connectionId: string, config?: {
        responseRequested?: boolean;
        comment?: string;
    }): Promise<ConnectionProtocolMsgReturnType<TrustPingMessage>>;
```

## Parameters

| Parameter    | Type                                               | Description                                                       |
| ------------ | -------------------------------------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------- |
| connectionId | string                                             | the id of the connection for which to create a trust ping message |
| config       | { responseRequested?: boolean; comment?: string; } | <i>(Optional)</i> the config for the trust ping message           |

<b>Returns:</b>

Promise&lt;[ConnectionProtocolMsgReturnType](./core.connectionprotocolmsgreturntype.md)&lt;[TrustPingMessage](./core.trustpingmessage.md)&gt;&gt;

outbound message containing trust ping message
